argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\WebAIBridge'
$cfg=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0' -TimeoutSec 3
$as=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments' -TimeoutSec 3
Write-Output ('AUTOCONTINUE='+$cfg.config.autoContinueEnabled)
Write-Output ('AUTOSEND='+$cfg.config.allowAutonomousSend)
Write-Output ('PARALLEL='+$cfg.config.maxParallelAgents)
Write-Output ('ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS='+@($as.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
Write-Output ('BLOCKED_ASSIGNMENTS='+@($as.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -eq 'blocked'}).Count)
Write-Output ('R45_RUNNER_SOURCE_EXISTS='+(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'app\autonomy-r45-runner.js')))
Write-Output ('R57_GPT_GIT_SOURCE_EXISTS='+(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'app\autonomy-r57-gpt-git.js')))
Write-Output ('R57_SUCCESSOR_SOURCE_EXISTS='+(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'app\autonomy-r57-successor.js')))
$procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"|Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'autonomy-r45-runner\.js'})
Write-Output ('ACTUAL_R45_RUNNER_PROCESSES='+$procs.Count)
$planPaths=@((Join-Path $root 'app\data\autonomy-r45-plan.json'),(Join-Path $root 'app\autonomy-r45-plan.json'))
Write-Output ('PLAN_FILES_AT_STANDARD_PATHS='+@($planPaths|Where-Object {Test-Path -LiteralPath $_}).Count)
Write-Output ('PRODUCTION_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD))
data.stdout:
